name: Shopify
one_liner: Shopify provides a suite of REST and GraphQL APIs for store data, storefront, and partner operations.
auth_notes: Access tokens are obtained via OAuth flows and sent in the X-Shopify-Access-Token header.
access_notes: Merchants must approve the app to grant access tokens.

extras.rate_limits: All APIs are subject to rate limits.

evidence.snippet: - With a few APIs, you’ll need to request access from Shopify and be approved before you can start making calls.
Shopify App Pricing is the default option when you submit a new public app for approval.
